title.zh: Securitize 在 Solana 上推出代币化美股
title.en: Securitize Launches Tokenized US Stocks on Solana

current_state.zh: Securitize 已在 Solana 区块链上推出包括 Nvidia、Apple 和 Amazon 在内的主要美国股票的代币化版本，将现实世界资产代币化扩展至蓝筹股。
current_state.en: Securitize has launched tokenized versions of major US equities including Nvidia, Apple and Amazon on the Solana blockchain, extending real-world-asset tokenization to blue-chip stocks.

updates.title_zh: Securitize将苹果、英伟达和特斯拉引入Solana，纽交所交易也在筹备中
updates.title_en: Securitize brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana, with NYSE trading in the works
updates.what_changed_zh: Securitize正在其基于Solana的平台上推出苹果、英伟达和特斯拉的代币化股票，并计划将这些代币扩展至纽交所和OKX数字交易场所。
updates.what_changed_en: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.current_state_zh: Securitize正在其基于Solana的平台上推出苹果、英伟达和特斯拉的代币化股票，并计划将这些代币扩展至纽交所和OKX数字交易场所。
updates.current_state_en: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.background_zh: Securitize 是一家在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）注册的过户代理与代币化平台，其自身在 NYSE 上市的 A 类股票以原生方式在链上发行。自 7 月在 NYSE 上市以来，其股票已在 Solana 上交易，而 SEC 的“创新豁免”为代币化股票开辟了一条合规路径。从 Coinbase 到 NYSE，以及 OKX-ICE 合资项目等竞争对手也已进入该领域。
updates.background_en: Securitize is an SEC-registered transfer agent and tokenization platform whose own NYSE-listed Class A stock is issued natively onchain. Its shares have traded on Solana since its NYSE listing in July, and the SEC's "innovation exemption" opened a compliant path for tokenized stocks. Rivals from Coinbase to the NYSE and an OKX-ICE venture have also moved into the space.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上线将以 USDC 结算的代币化美股敞口引入 Solana 生态，Securitize 提到 Ripple Prime 和 Aave 作为链上借贷与抵押用途的合作方，这可能为链上信贷市场增加一类新的抵押品。对 NYSE 和 OKX-ICE 交易场所的影响仍属条件性，因为两者均处于计划阶段、尚未上线。
updates.market_impact_en: The launch channels tokenized U.S. equity exposure into the Solana ecosystem with USDC settlement, and Securitize names Ripple Prime and Aave as partners for onchain lending and collateral use, which could add a new collateral category to onchain credit markets. Any effect on the NYSE and OKX-ICE venues remains contingent, since both are still planned and not live.

updates.title_zh: Securitize将苹果、英伟达等12只美股上链Solana，并计划扩展至纽交所数字平台
updates.title_en: Securitize将苹果、英伟达等12只美股上链Solana，并计划扩展至纽交所数字平台
updates.what_changed_zh: Securitize 宣布推出名为“Securitize Stocks”的产品，将 12 只美股（包括苹果、英伟达、特斯拉、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet、Meta、Netflix、Circle、Strategy、Palantir 等）上链 Solana；每只代币由 1:1 实际股份支撑，Jump Trading 提供流动性，USDC 结算，并计划扩展至纽交所 24/7 数字交易平台及 ICE-OKX 合资的 OKXICE 平台。
updates.what_changed_en: Securitize announced 'Securitize Stocks', tokenizing 12 US equities on Solana (including Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Netflix, Circle, Strategy, Palantir); each token backed 1:1 by actual shares, with Jump Trading liquidity and USDC settlement, and plans to expand to NYSE's 24/7 digital venue and the ICE-OKX OKXICE platform.
updates.current_state_zh: Securitize 已在 Solana 上推出“Securitize Stocks”，将 12 只美股代币化，每只代币 1:1 由实际股份支撑，Jump Trading 提供流动性，USDC 结算，并计划扩展至纽交所 24/7 数字交易平台及 ICE-OKX 的 OKXICE 代币化证券平台。
updates.current_state_en: Securitize has launched 'Securitize Stocks' on Solana, tokenizing 12 US equities with 1:1 share backing, Jump Trading liquidity, USDC settlement, and planned expansion to NYSE's 24/7 digital venue and the ICE-OKX OKXICE tokenized-securities platform.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Securitize launched "Securitize Stocks" on Solana, tokenizing 12 major US equities including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla with 1:1 share backing, Jump Trading liquidity and USDC settlement, with planned expansion to NYSE's 24/7 digital trading venue and the ICE-OKX OKXICE tokenized-securities platform.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Securitize launched "Securitize Stocks" on Solana, tokenizing 12 major US equities including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla with 1:1 share backing, Jump Trading liquidity and USDC settlement, with planned expansion to NYSE's 24/7 digital trading venue and the ICE-OKX OKXICE tokenized-securities platform.
